sentences.en: Ravenswood pleaded, apologised, and even kneeled, to appease her displeasure.
sentences.zh: 瑞文伍德恳求、道歉，甚至跪下以平息她的不满。

sentences.en: Sherlock Holmes approached the body, and kneeling down, examined it intently.
sentences.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯走近尸体，跪下仔细检查。

sentences.en: The general surrenders and kneels in before the enemy.
sentences.zh: 将军投降并跪在敌人的面前。
